headline: Clean file with one thing to clear: the practice trades as Kairos Physio without a matching DBA filing, and control rests on the website rather than the registry.

body.text: Two things are open against the policy: the unregistered trading name in Business identity, and control evidence that Ownership can only take as far as a website match, because New York publishes no members for a PLLC. Neither is adverse — screening is clean and the entity is active — but both are name-and-control checks a KYB policy usually gates on, and the steps below close them with the customer rather than with an order.

followUps.text: Ask the customer for the assumed-name filing for "Kairos Physio", or confirm they trade only under the legal name.
Establish who owns the practice from the customer directly — New York publishes no members for a PLLC, so no order reaches it, and the control person named on the website is not necessarily an owner.
Verify the control person against a document rather than the website.
Decide whether professional licensure needs checking separately; this record does not cover it.
If good standing is gating, request the certificate — New York publishes no sub-status.
